description: Nora, a dog walker, is deciding whether to accept a neighbor's offer to exchange dog walks for produce, and must settle the number of walks, the produce exchange, the dates, and the dog's walking precautions with input from the neighbor and the neighbor's housemate.

shared_context.S1: Eli needs help exercising his dog during the first two weeks of September.
shared_context.S2: Nora regularly walks dogs in the neighborhood and sometimes accepts produce or other goods instead of cash.
shared_context.S3: Eli grows vegetables in the community garden, and Tess lives with Eli and the dog.
shared_context.S4: Nora makes the final call on whether to accept the arrangement and records the agreed terms.
shared_context.S5: As part of Nora's usual arrangement check, she asks Eli and Tess in turn to state the practical terms and any care instructions aloud before she decides.

PF1.text: Eli's exact proposal is six 45-minute walks from September 2 through September 13, in exchange for three produce boxes delivered to Nora on September 14, with no cash payment.

PF2.text: Tess has seen the dog react badly to crowded dog-park paths; for these walks the dog must use a front-clip harness and the side-street route, with no dog-park stop.

acceptance_conditions: Nora must accept Eli's exact barter proposal.
The arrangement must include six 45-minute walks from September 2 through September 13.
Eli must provide three produce boxes on September 14 and no cash payment may be included.
The walking plan must require the front-clip harness and side-street route.
The dog-park stop must be disallowed.
The settlement must encode all three specified safety terms.
Tess's safety information must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C2: decisions['walk_count'] == 6 and decisions['walk_duration_minutes'] == 45 and decisions['walk_start_date'] in ['September 2', '2024-09-02'] and decisions['walk_end_date'] in ['September 13', '2024-09-13']
content_checks.C5: decisions['walking_route'] in ['side-street', 'side-street route'] and decisions['harness_required'] == True and decisions['dog_park_stop_allowed'] == False

decisive_facts.why: Eli's exact proposal changes the settlement from an unspecified possible exchange to six 45-minute walks on September 2-13 for exactly three produce boxes delivered September 14 with exactly zero cash.

Tess's observation changes the walking terms from an ordinary route to the exact side-street route with a front-clip harness and no dog-park stop, requiring those three specific safety fields and citation.
